title: Tematos Stuff
description: A Fun mod that adds a bunch of completely random stuff. With many more features to come!
body:
![The Temato's Stuff Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2a3564603c4db3330b72dbfbdd322a79215f7edb.png)

Welcome to **Temato's Stuff**! This mod adds a whole bunch of fun things, with much more to come!

This mod is perfect for uh... something...
It just adds some miscelanious stuff that aren't very realistic for minecraft but could possibly fun to see. It's a fun mod for everyone! Explorers, PVP'ers, builders and people who enjoy eating uranium.

It adds:

- Plushies
- Tomatoes
- New weapons (knife, scythe, Lithium swords and Carbon updgraded lithium Items (I know, very complicated sounding)
- A bunch of new foods (mostly to do with the tomatoes)
- Lithium
- Uranium
- Irradiated caves
- Some miscellaneous building blocks
_and more to come!_

!I DO NOT KNOW IF THIS PROJECT WORKS WITH MULTIPLAYER, YOU CAN TRY THIS BUT PLEASE DO AT YOUR OWN RISK!

Project created with MCreator
